name: Build Main House Structure
description: Create the main rectangular body for the house walls.

name: Build Gable Roof
description: Extrude a triangular roof profile across the top of the house with overhangs.
code:
def build_roof(self):
    roof_length_total = self.house_length + 2 * self.roof_overhang
    roof_width_total = self.house_width + 2 * self.roof_overhang
    top_z = self.house_height / 2.0
    peak_z = top_z + self.roof_height
    roof = (
        self.model.faces(">Y")
        .workplane(offset=self.roof_overhang)
        .polyline([
            (-roof_length_total / 2.0, top_z),
            (0.0, peak_z),
            (roof_length_total / 2.0, top_z)
        ])
        .close()
        .extrude(-roof_width_total)
    )
    self.model = self.model.union(roof)

name: Add Front Door
description: Cut a recessed entrance door into the front face of the house.
code:
def add_door(self):
    door_z_center = -self.house_height / 2.0 + self.door_height / 2.0
    door_y_center = self.house_width / 2.0
    door = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=door_z_center)
        .center(0.0, door_y_center)
        .box(self.door_width, self.door_depth * 2.0, self.door_height)
    )
    self.model = self.model.cut(door)

name: Add Windows
description: Cut recessed window openings into the front facade.
code:
def add_windows(self):
    win1 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=self.window_offset_y)
        .center(-self.window_offset_x, self.house_width / 2.0)
        .box(self.window_width, self.window_depth * 2.0, self.window_height)
    )
    win2 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=self.window_offset_y)
        .center(self.window_offset_x, self.house_width / 2.0)
        .box(self.window_width, self.window_depth * 2.0, self.window_height)
    )
    self.model = self.model.cut(win1).cut(win2)

name: Hollow Out House
description: Hollow out the interior of the house by cutting an inner box.
code:
def hollow_house(self):
    inner_length = self.house_length - 2 * self.wall_thickness
    inner_width = self.house_width - 2 * self.wall_thickness
    inner_height = self.house_height - 2 * self.wall_thickness
    inner_box = cq.Workplane("XY").box(inner_length, inner_width, inner_height)
    self.model = self.model.cut(inner_box)

name: Add Side Windows
description: Cut windows into the side of the house.
code:
def add_side_windows(self):
    win1 = (
        cq.Workplane("YZ")
        .workplane(offset=-self.house_length / 2.0)
        .center(-self.side_window_offset_y, self.side_window_offset_z)
        .box(self.side_window_width, self.side_window_height, self.side_window_depth * 2.0)
    )
    win2 = (
        cq.Workplane("YZ")
        .workplane(offset=-self.house_length / 2.0)
        .center(self.side_window_offset_y, self.side_window_offset_z)
        .box(self.side_window_width, self.side_window_height, self.side_window_depth * 2.0)
    )
    self.model = self.model.cut(win1).cut(win2)
